row.Title: Technical Data Sheet CarbonFil
row.Source note: FormFutura's one-page technical data sheet for CarbonFil, updated 23-8-2024, as the retailer 3DJake serves it (linked from its product page https://www.3djake.com/formfutura/carbonfil-grey): a scan with an optical text layer. It describes CarbonFil as "a 15% carbon fiber reinforced PETG based 3D printer filament" and prints material properties (specific gravity, Charpy, tensile strength and elongation at break, a flexural modulus, Vicat) and recommended drying, enclosure and print settings. A later revision of S-PET-TDS-CarbonFil (undated, 20 % carbon fibre, specific gravity 1.19), whose rows stay.
row.Access note: Fetched 2026-09-17 by the V2 import from 3DJake's copy (docs/audits/2026-09-18-v2-import/ledger.csv, doc_key 7b525961687e2d89), hash-checked; its text is an optical reading (ocrmypdf, 2026-09-19). Registered under S-PET-TDS-CarbonFil as a revision until batch b46 admitted it as a source of its own (2026-10-18, screening build C14).

evidence.text: CarbonFil is a 15% carbon fiber reinforced PETG based 3D printer filament that is extremely stiff.
